findings.repair: Kernel advisory lock; durable operation phases; receipt material/path bound before commit; journal retained until receipt durability; status/recover classification of before/after/diverged state.
findings.summary: The fail-closed lock/journal has no liveness or recovery protocol, and authoritative receipts are written after the journal is cleared.

findings.repair: Full object digest path; same-filesystem staging; object/store kernel lock; verify-and-reuse existing object; explicit quarantine on corruption; no-clobber publication and crash/concurrency tests.
findings.summary: Build deletes and replaces an existing same-identity artifact destination, violating the immutable object-digest store contract and creating races.

findings.repair: Reject floating references in release mode and resolve workload bundles plus transitive closure to immutable digests.
findings.summary: The canonical services/nginx:latest workload closure passes through spec, lock, and plan unresolved.

findings.repair: Separate base OS, third-party package, and workload bundle resolvers and trust policies.
findings.summary: The fixture labels third-party www/nginx as pkgbase, conflating FreeBSD base-system delivery with Ports/pkg packages.

findings.repair: Exclude archive cut metadata from content identity; bind exact builder, resolver, policy, schema, and backend digests.
findings.summary: Changing only generated_for_version changes runtime content identity.

findings.repair: Publish explicit integrity/authenticity/authorization/executor/observer/acceptance strength and export standard signed provenance.
findings.summary: Unsigned self-authored dry-run receipts provide integrity and traceability but not hostile-builder-resistant or independently observed proof.

findings.repair: Use fleet_host and compile defaults from one small canonical profile registry.
findings.summary: Runtime profile-a-fleet-host differs from documented canonical fleet_host.
